review.fitness_expert_summary: This back/bicep workout for a 64-year-old intermediate has good equipment utilization for outdoor training, but suffers from poor exercise ordering (isolation before compounds), questionable exercise selections, and inadequate compound movements. The trap-heavy focus leaves major back muscles undertrained.
review.product_engineer_summary: Multiple filter failures: obscure exercise selection, compound-isolation ordering violations, and missing foundational movement prioritization. The outdoor equipment constraints seem to be driving poor exercise choices rather than finding better band-based compounds.

issues.fix_suggestion: Add age >= 60 filter to block straight-arm pullover variations in SmartExerciseSelectionEngine.

improvement_suggestions.title: Prioritize canonical chest movements over obscure variations
improvement_suggestions.rationale: The system selected multiple non-standard exercises when user has access to Smith machine, barbell, and other equipment for proven chest builders like bench press, incline press, dips.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: Fit33/FoundationalExerciseDatabase.swift - increase priority scores for canonical movements, decrease for experimental/obscure exercises

improvement_suggestions.title: Remove biomechanically questionable exercises from database
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Single-arm barbell floor press and unclear 'Lateral Hit' exercises don't belong in a foundational strength program and confuse the selection algorithm.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: Exercise database audit - remove or recategorize exercises that don't follow established movement patterns

improvement_suggestions.title: Add movement pattern diversity enforcement
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Two consecutive single-arm floor press variations shows the pairing engine isn't checking for movement pattern redundancy within the same workout.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: Fit33/SmartExercisePairingEngine.swift - add consecutive exercise movement pattern similarity check

kept_or_swap.rationale: Multiple obscure exercises and poor movement selection requires substantial algorithm improvements.
